About.title: Our Heritage
About.subtitle: Preserving the legacy of fine tobacco since 1995.
About.tradition_text1: Welcome to CigarLounge, where passion meets precision. Founded over three decades ago by a collective of aficionados, we established this sanctuary with a singular mission: to curate the world's finest cigars for the discerning smoker.
About.tradition_text2: We believe that a cigar is not just a product, but an experience—a pause in time where craftsmanship and flavor converge. From the fertile soils of Pinar del Río to the volcanic richness of Nicaragua, our selection represents the pinnacle of agricultural and artisanal achievement.
About.humidor_text: Our state-of-the-art humidor ensures every cigar is kept at optimal humidity and temperature.
About.quote: If I cannot smoke cigars in Heaven, I shall not go.

Guide.title: User Guide & Manual
Guide.subtitle: Navigate our ecosystem with ease. Here is everything you need to know about our Web Platform and Telegram Bot.
Guide.web_first_time: For First-Time Users (Navigating the Digital Lounge)
Guide.web_first_desc: Our web platform is designed to make catalog browsing and account management completely seamless:
Guide.web_create_desc: Click Sign Up in the top right corner. Enter your email and choose a secure password.
Guide.web_profile_desc: Drop by your dashboard to save your preferences. Make sure to use the same mobile number you use on Telegram so your web profile and bot stay perfectly synced.
Guide.web_humidor_desc: Head over to our catalog page. You can filter premium selections by singles, boxes, samplers, or size profiles (Vitolas).
Guide.web_checkout_desc: Add items to your cart and proceed to checkout. Your order history will instantly reflect across both the website and your Telegram app.
Guide.web_sync_desc: If your web order history isn't showing up on your Telegram bot, verify that your phone number matches exactly on both platforms.
Guide.web_cache_desc: If product availability or images look outdated after a major stock update, simply log out, clear your browser cookies, and log back in to force a fresh pull from the database.
Guide.web_support_desc: If you prefer typing on a keyboard over your phone, the live chat widget on the bottom right of the website routes directly to the exact same support hub as our Telegram assistant.
Guide.desktop_desc: For the fastest, uninterrupted experience, download our native Desktop App.
Guide.bot_first_desc: Getting started with our automated lounge companion is effortless. Follow these steps to explore our collection:
Guide.bot_start_desc: Open the chat and tap the Start button (or type /start). This initializes your profile and opens the main menu.
Guide.bot_link_desc: Tap the 🔗 Link Store Account button. The bot will securely request your phone number to automatically sync your past lounge purchases and active profile.
Guide.bot_explore_desc: Tap 🔥 Enter the Humidor to instantly browse our live stock of premium samplers, bundles, and cigarillos.
Guide.bot_search_desc: You don't need a menu to search. Simply type any brand name (e.g., Oliva, Plasencia, or Camacho) directly into the chat, and the bot will instantly reply with our current inventory.
Guide.bot_human_desc: If you have a custom request or an issue, type /chat. The bot will instantly patch you through to a live lounge agent.
Guide.bot_return_desc: If you are already registered but things aren't working as expected, use these quick resets:
Guide.bot_reset_desc: If the bot stops responding or feels stuck, type /start at any time. This refreshes the core interface without losing your linked account data.
Guide.bot_unstuck_desc: If you were speaking with a live agent and want to return to browsing products automatically, type /end to close the support ticket and bring back the search engine.
Guide.bot_commands_desc: Tap the Menu button next to your chat box to see a clean list of all active shortcuts.
Guide.bot_connect_desc: Access our Telegram bot directly below.

Loyalty.title: Aficionado Club Policy
Loyalty.subtitle: Earn points with every purchase and unlock exclusive rewards as you climb the ranks of our elite membership program.
Loyalty.earning_desc: You earn 1 point for every EGP 10 spent on cigars and accessories. Gold and Platinum members earn at an accelerated rate.
Loyalty.expiration_desc: Your tier status is valid for 12 months from the date you qualify. Maintain your points balance to keep your status.

Policy.returns_guarantee_text: We stand behind the quality of our products. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, simply contact us within 15 days of receipt.
Policy.returns_eli_1: Cigars must be in their original packaging and humidified condition.
Policy.returns_eli_2: Accessories must be unused and in original packaging.
Policy.returns_eli_3: Any "Sampler Packs" must be returned in full.
Policy.returns_how_text: To start a return, please contact our Customer Care team at support@cigarlounge.com with your Order #. We will provide you with a return shipping label and instructions.
Policy.shipping_processing_text: All orders are processed within 1-2 business days. Orders are not shipped or delivered on weekends or holidays. If we are experiencing a high volume of orders, shipments may be delayed by a few days.
Policy.shipping_rates_text: Shipping charges for your order will be calculated and displayed at checkout.
Policy.shipping_standard_desc: 3-5 business days - Free for Gold/Platinum members or orders over $100.
Policy.shipping_intl_text: We currently ship to select international destinations. Please note that custom duties and taxes are the responsibility of the customer.
